social.og_title: WinProx — Digital time clock for time tracking
social.og_description: Staff clock in with their phone, without an app. You compare the hours with the roster and pass them to your social secretariat.

hero.headline: The digital time clock for time tracking in your company.
hero.subtitle: Staff clock in with their phone, without an app. You compare the hours with the roster and pass them to your social secretariat. If your crew works at customer sites, you can turn on presence reporting to the social security office.
hero.trial: Trial: 30 days, 3 seats, after you request it.

feature_board.title: Working at customer sites
feature_board.text: Turn on presence reporting to the social security office when your crew works at customer sites. Cleaning for third parties is available now. Construction follows on 1 April 2027.

clock.title: A small, elegant time clock for your business
clock.lead: Employees clock in and out with their own linked smartphone at the company's time clock. No app, no badge and no biometric identification.
items: Fixed clock screen with a rotating QR code
Time and attendance registration in WinProx
Optional verification photo when clocking in or out
Extra protection against misuse, without biometric identification
Also works as a QR sticker, no screen needed
Compare the hours with the roster.
Pass the hours to your social secretariat.
clock.close: More control over who clocks in, when and where — without badges or biometric data.
